plugins.description: Agent skills for using the yggdryl package from Rust, Python and Node.js: types, Arrow columns, storage and HTTP serving, warehouses, record media (Parquet, Iceberg, Excel, XMLA), documents, expressions, hashing, FIX, market data and logging.
